description: This file defines multiple classes related to transactional grains in Orleans, including base classes and specific grain implementations that manage transactional state for testing purposes.

classes.name: GrainData
classes.description: A serializable class representing a grain's state data with a single integer property.

classes.name: MaxStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain class that manages multiple transactional states initialized with a range of identifiers, used for testing maximum state scenarios.

classes.name: DoubleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain managing two transactional states, each with its own identifier, for testing multiple state transactions.

classes.name: SingleStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain managing a single transactional state, representing a simple transactional grain scenario.

classes.name: NoStateTransactionalGrain
classes.description: A grain with no transactional state, used for testing grains that do not manage state.

classes.name: MultiStateTransactionalGrainBaseClass
classes.description: A base class providing common transactional behaviors for grains managing multiple states, includes methods for setting, adding, getting state, and throwing exceptions.

classes.name: AddAndThrowException
classes.description: A custom exception class used in testing transaction failures.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the logger upon grain activation.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates all transactional states with a new value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified number to each state value and returns the updated values.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves current values from all transactional states.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to the states and then throws an exception to simulate failure.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Sets a value and then throws an exception to simulate failure.
